what: per entity that was asked about: the median monthly search-referred readers of its Wikipedia article, per language that has one
a_zero_is_a_reading: the clickstream omits any (referrer, article) pair under ten clicks a month for privacy, so an article with no row is measured as under ten rather than unmeasured
what_this_does_not_establish: that a family intent exists in a market. It answers only whether this entity is sought by speakers of this language.
